```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Global epidemics constitute a major security threat.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Malaria is running out of control in Africa.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Antibiotic-resistant strains of tuberculosis are ravaging Russia and other countries.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"HIV/AIDS is more than a health tragedy; it is a threat to global security.",
"claim_types":["evaluation","factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"AIDS now grips 20 million Africans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Fourteen million Africans have already died from AIDS, a quarter of them children.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Each day, 11,000 more men, women, and children become infected with AIDS.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Diseases like AIDS threaten not just individual citizens, but the very institutions that define and defend the character of society.",
"claim_types":["evaluation","factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party believes we can and must do more to prevent transmission, care for those who are ill, and lead in knitting together the scores of AIDS-fighting initiatives into a global campaign to defeat this threat.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"International drug networks and other organized crime syndicates represent a growing threat to the survival of democratic governance.",
"claim_types":["evaluation","factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"International drug networks and other organized crime syndicates breed corruption and lawlessness.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"International drug networks and other organized crime syndicates erode the institutions that maintain societal order.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
